source: Scorvec midterms-2026 district lean static dataset; derived from MIT Election Data and Science Lab precinct vote returns, VEST 2020 precinct election results, 2020 Census blocks, 120th congressional district equivalency, state totals and county-based swing. Model-derived allocations are approximate (particularly in redrawn districts).
sourceLicense: Derived dataset includes MIT-licensed processing code, MEDSL CC0 and VEST CC BY 4.0 source inputs; preserve original credits. Do not assert all estimates are verified official district tallies.
notes: District-level reallocated 2024 and 2020 presidential election votes and two-party D−R margins. Map-verified=false for all 173 2026 redrawn seats; estimates rely on split precinct/block and county/cell swing assumptions. These are historical reconstructed returns, never recorded votes in 2026. Missouri remains the pre-redraw 2022/2024 2026 ballot plan.
